title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Given two integers, find their sum.
input_format: Two integers, A and B, separated by a space.
output_format: The sum of A and B.

title: Reverse a String
description: Given a string, reverse it.
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The reversed string S.

title: Factorial Calculation
description: Calculate the factorial of a given non-negative integer.
input_format: A non-negative integer N.
output_format: The factorial of N.

title: Check if a Number is Prime
description: Determine if a given integer is a prime number.
input_format: An integer N.
output_format: Print 'Prime' if N is prime, otherwise print 'Not Prime'.

title: Find the Largest Element in an Array
description: Find the largest element in a given array of integers.
input_format: First line contains the number of elements N. Second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The largest element in the array.

title: Count Vowels
description: Count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a given string (case-insensitive).
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The number of vowels in S.

title: Palindrome Check
description: Determine if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same backward as forward, ignoring case).
input_format: A string S.
output_format: Print 'Palindrome' if S is a palindrome, otherwise print 'Not Palindrome'.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Generate the nth Fibonacci number.
input_format: An integer N.
output_format: The nth Fibonacci number.

title: Calculate Average
description: Calculate the average of a list of numbers.
input_format: First line contains the number of elements N. Second line contains N numbers separated by spaces.
output_format: The average of the numbers, rounded to two decimal places.

title: Leap Year Check
description: Determine if a given year is a leap year.
input_format: An integer representing a year.
output_format: Print 'Leap Year' if the year is a leap year, otherwise print 'Not Leap Year'.

title: String Length
description: Calculate the length of a given string.
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The length of the string S.

title: Swap Variables
description: Swap the values of two integer variables without using a temporary variable.
input_format: Two integers A and B, separated by a space.
output_format: Two integers, B and A, separated by a space.

title: Reverse an Array
description: Reverse the elements of an array in place.
input_format: First line contains the number of elements N. Second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The reversed array, with elements separated by spaces.

title: Find the Minimum Element in an Array
description: Find the smallest element in a given array of integers.
input_format: First line contains the number of elements N. Second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The smallest element in the array.

title: Remove Duplicates from an Array
description: Remove duplicate elements from a sorted array.
input_format: First line contains the number of elements N. Second line contains N sorted integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The array with duplicates removed, with elements separated by spaces.

title: Implement Power Function
description: Calculate A raised to the power of B (A^B).
input_format: Two integers, A and B, separated by a space.
output_format: The value of A^B.

title: Binary to Decimal Conversion
description: Convert a binary number (represented as a string) to its decimal equivalent.
input_format: A string representing a binary number.
output_format: The decimal equivalent of the binary number.
constraints: 1 <= length of Binary String <= 8; The string will only contain 0s and 1s.

title: Decimal to Binary Conversion
description: Convert a decimal number to its binary equivalent (represented as a string).
input_format: A non-negative integer.
output_format: The binary equivalent of the decimal number.

title: Anagram Check
description: Determine if two given strings are anagrams of each other (contain the same characters in different orders).
input_format: Two strings, S1 and S2, separated by a newline.
output_format: Print 'Anagram' if the strings are anagrams, otherwise print 'Not Anagram'.

title: Greatest Common Divisor (GCD)
description: Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two positive integers.
input_format: Two positive integers A and B, separated by a space.
output_format: The GCD of A and B.
